extraction_warnings: No individual-level subject_id or sample_id data are provided in the main text; only aggregate group-level counts (41 controls, 56 pHTN, 99 HTN) are reported.
Age, sex distribution, and BMI values are referenced only via 'Additional file 1: Table S1', which is not included in the provided text, so these fields are marked not_reported.
PMID (28143587) was taken from the paper_id metadata rather than from in-text citation; no verbatim evidence quote exists in the body text.
Sequencing platform for human fecal metagenomic samples is stated generically as 'Illumina platform' without a specific instrument model (e.g., HiSeq/MiSeq), so the enum mapping is uncertain.

This paper also includes an animal (germ-free mouse) fecal transplantation experiment and a validation cohort (Qin et al. dataset) with 6 subjects; these were not separately extracted as they represent different granularity (mouse recipients, small validation subset) not matching the main human cohort schema fields requested.

Granularity was set to subgroup_level based on control/pHTN/HTN case-control status; most other fields (country, body_site, DNA extraction kit, antibiotics exclusion period) are uniform across subgroups and reported at study level.
Age and BMI numeric values were referenced as compared covariates but not reported in the main text (likely in Additional file 1: Table S1, which was not provided).
Study includes an FMT sub-experiment with 3 human donors (2 HTN, 1 control) and germ-free mouse recipients; fmt_role was extracted only for the human donors since recipients were non-human.
Smoker and antibiotics_current_use fields were inferred from exclusion criteria rather than directly stated participant-level data.

Disease/disease_details fields reflect the three main human cohort subgroups (control, pHTN, HTN); a separate FMT donor subset (2 HTN + 1 control) was not treated as an additional subgroup to avoid overcomplicating granularity.
Batch 2 returned granularity='study_level', differs from batch 0 ('subgroup_level'); kept batch 0.
Batch 2 subgroups [] differ from batch 0 ['control', 'pHTN', 'HTN']; kept batch 0.

Schema fields (biomarker_name/unit/value, disease_response_os, ecog_performance_status, feces_phenotype_value, tumor_size_measurement/residual) appear designed for oncology/clinical trial studies and are largely not applicable to this gut microbiome-hypertension study; most returned as not_reported.
Specific clinical biomarker values (BP, FBG, lipids) are referenced as being in Additional file 1: Table S1, which is not included in the provided text, so exact values/units could not be extracted.

Study involves both human participants and germ-free mice (FMT experiments); host_species field only allows one value, so 'Human' was chosen as the primary cohort species, with mouse use noted separately.
